def: to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises)
kjv: keept at home, prepare an habitation.

words.word: and i will prepare him an habitation

occurrences.text: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
words: and I will prepare him an habitation

occurrences.text: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
